---
title: "The document language overrides the per-language file of the project"
toc: true
language:
  toc-title-document: "Contents from the document"
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<h2 id="toc-title">Contents from the document</h2>']
        - ['Sommaire du projet', 'Contents from the project']
---

## Section

The project sets `lang: fr` and `language: custom.yml`, and has a `custom-fr.yml` file next to `custom.yml`.
The document sets `toc-title-document` under `language`.
The value of the document must replace the value of the French file of the project.
